home.title: Wishlists
home.lead: Add what you would like. Buyers sort it out here, and you don't get to see it.
home.listsIntro: Anyone can look. Log in to see who is buying what.

list.title: {name}'s wishlist
list.emptyOther: {name} hasn't put anything on the list yet.
list.ownerHint: You can't see who buys what. That stays a surprise.
list.anonHint: Log in to see who is buying what and to mark what you buy.
list.buyerHint: {name} can't see who buys what and doesn't read the notes.
list.removedIntro: {name} removed this after someone bought it. It stays here so you can sort it out.

item.deleteBody: The wish disappears from your list. You can't undo this.

purchase.title: Who is buying this?
purchase.label: How many are you buying?
purchase.removedItem: {name} took this off the list. You can only lower your amount or remove it.

form.title: Title
form.descriptionHint: Colour, size, why you want it. You can leave this empty.
form.urlHint: The address of a shop or an example. You can leave this empty.
form.imageHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP. Large photos are made smaller.
form.unlimitedHint: For things you can never have enough of, like puzzles.

auth.loginLead: Log in to see who is buying what.
auth.registerLead: An account gives you your own wishlist.
auth.displayNameHint: This is how others see you.
auth.usernameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Your list will be at {address}.

settings.title: Settings
settings.profileIntro: Your name and the text at the top of your list.
settings.listIntro: Text at the top of your list
settings.listIntroHint: Your sizes or what you like, for example. You can leave this empty.
settings.passwordIntro: Choose a new password. You stay logged in.

error.notFoundBody: The address is wrong, or the list is gone.
error.otherBody: Reload the page. If it keeps failing, try again later.

errors.validation: Check the fields below and try again.
errors.invalid_credentials: That email address or password is wrong.
errors.email_taken: An account with this email address already exists. Log in, or use another address.
errors.username_taken: That username is taken. Choose another.
errors.registration_closed: No more accounts can be added. Ask whoever runs the site.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait fifteen minutes and try again.
errors.forbidden: You can't do that on your own list.
errors.not_found: That no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.quantity_exceeded: There aren't that many left. Choose a smaller amount.
errors.item_removed: This wish was taken off the list. You can only lower your amount.
errors.item_limit: Your list is full. Delete a wish first.
errors.too_large: That is too large. Choose a smaller image or shorten your text.
errors.invalid_image: That file isn't a JPEG, PNG or WebP. Choose another image.
errors.bad_origin: This request came from another site and was refused.

fields.invalid_email: That isn't a valid email address.
fields.invalid_username: Use 3 to 30 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, and start and end with a letter or digit.
fields.password_short: Choose a password of at least 10 characters.
fields.invalid_url: Start the link with http:// or https://.
fields.invalid_amount: Choose a whole number of 1 or more.
